title: Arafat-er portfolio: design world choose koro
question: Roll e eshechhe 'Tong Cha-Dokan'. Eta rakho, ekta alternate nao, ba re-roll koro.

options.label: Tong Cha-Dokan
options.lineage: Hand-painted tin signboards of Bangladeshi tea stalls
options.thesis: The portfolio is your tong: a friendly tea stall where every project hangs on the menu board.
options.viewport: A painted teal tin signboard reading 'Arafat's Tong' with the menu board listing Rivo, Meal Bazar, Tong and Mentora; a steaming cha glass is the contact button.
options.risk: Can tip into kitsch if the lettering is clip-art rather than confidently hand-painted.

options.label: Grid Brutal
options.thesis: Bold color blocks, thick black outlines, buttons that physically press into their shadow.
options.viewport: A grid of outlined project blocks under a huge name, every card clickable with a snap-press.
options.risk: Very popular style right now; needs Bangla touches to feel like you.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: playful like Josh, and a recruiter can scan the grid in seconds.

options.label: Step Sequencer
options.thesis: Your skills and projects are 16 candy step keys; press run and the chase light plays your career.
options.viewport: A machine panel with name as the model badge; 16 step keys, each a project or skill, light up in sequence.
options.risk: Fun and memorable, but recruiters must still find plain project details fast.
options.case: Fuses well: playful toy-like interaction; the GitHub contribution rhythm maps to the step row.

options.label: Course Map
options.thesis: Your journey as a course: numbered purple controls from JUST to Syftet to shipped apps.
options.viewport: A contour map ground with a purple course linking control points, each a milestone or project.
options.risk: Less 'playful' in Josh's sense; more clever and calm.
options.case: Fuses fairly: the journey story fits, but the playful feel you liked is weaker.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean developer portfolio done at full craft: hero, projects grid, about, contact.
canonCard.viewport: Name and role headline, a project card grid, then about and contact.
canonCard.risk: Safe and familiar; this is the genre you called generic.
